description.es: Cabañas de estilo maya contemporáneo en la selva (Junior y Master con jacuzzi), restaurante orgánico y centro de bienestar: temazcal, ceremonia de cacao, ritual de luna llena, yoga y terapias de sanación. Senderos, avistamiento de aves, jardín botánico y meliponario; tours a sitios sagrados mayas, cenotes y lagunas. LGBTQ+ friendly.
description.en: Contemporary Maya-style jungle cabins (Junior and Master with jacuzzi), an organic restaurant and wellness center: temazcal, cacao ceremony, full-moon ritual, yoga and healing therapies. Trails, birdwatching, botanical garden and meliponario; tours to sacred Maya sites, cenotes and lagoons. LGBTQ+ friendly.

contactNote: Verified with the operator Oct 2026 (banner client, kind: offer). Prices: wellness $500, tours $800, cabins $1,000–1,200 MXN. Marker logo pending November feature.
